metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Egor Fedorov: context-optimizer (Haiku subagents, read dedup and an audit of what each session really costs) and cco-arcade.

plugins.name: context-optimizer
plugins.description: Spend less of your Claude usage on re-reading. In chat: a fresh-start handoff, token checks and prompt sharpening. In Claude Code and Cowork: Haiku 5.5 subagents do the reading and test runs so the expensive model's context stays small, plus read dedup, budget and cache-break warnings, and /cco-audit of your own transcripts. Local, no telemetry.

plugins.name: cco-arcade
plugins.description: The waiting game for Claude Code: live session dashboard + idle 'Token City' fed by your real agent activity (Godzilla wrecks it if you stop coding), plus desktop/phone pings when Claude finishes or needs you
